description: Create row/column guides on every page of a spread (Spread.createGuides). Set numberOfRows and/or numberOfColumns above 0; with both 0 nothing is created (the result reports the guide count before and after).

fitMargins.description: If true, rows/columns divide the area inside the page margins; if false, the full page

guideColor.description: Guide color: a UIColors name (e.g. BLUE, LIGHT_BLUE, GRID_GREEN) or "R,G,B" with each value 0-255

layerName.description: Name of an existing layer to create the guides on (default: active layer)

numberOfColumns.description: Number of columns to create on each page (0-100)

numberOfRows.description: Number of rows to create on each page (0-100)

removeExisting.description: Remove existing guides when creating the new ones

name: create_spread_guides
title: Create Spread Guides
